answer: Story: "Creepy Crawlies" (people.kernel.org), 727 points. SUPPORTING — wongarsu: proof-of-work scales as a defense because scrapers fetch orders of magnitude more pages than humans, so the per-page cost falls overwhelmingly on bots. COUNTERARGUMENT — semiquaver: it's an unwinnable arms race, since no difficulty is both bot-deterring and human-usable — they wrote a native ARM SHA-256 accelerator in minutes that solves in milliseconds a challenge costing an iPhone 17 three minutes. Usernames: wongarsu (supporting), semiquaver (criticism).
